name: Up super: a super from an up dash's coyote frames
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). Standing facing left, dash up-left with jump on dash frame 6: the dash has lifted the dot 145 u but onGround lasts through the coyote frames (coyoteFrames 1 on frame 5), so the jump is the super (805 up, 876 momentum left after the tick) from up there. It is in the finish box (x -300 to -200, y 200-320) on tick 11. Straight up (variant straight: dash (0, 1), the stick left through the dash) the super leaves on dash frame 6 at y 227 and crosses into the box at y 305 on tick 18; a flat super is at y 60-110 over that stretch and reaches y 200 only past x -450.
